sentences.en: You know so much about the wildlife here, PK.
sentences.zh: 你对这里的野生动物了解这么多，PK，是怎么回事？

sentences.en: How come?
sentences.zh: 怎么知道的？

sentences.en: My family are San, bush people, and I learned about nature from the time when I was a child.
sentences.zh: 我的家人是桑人，也就是丛林地居民，我从小就了解大自然。

sentences.en: I was born in the Kalahari.
sentences.zh: 我出生在卡拉哈里。

sentences.en: And you grew up and found your wife here?
sentences.zh: 你长大后也是在这里找到妻子的？

sentences.en: Yes, finding a wife here was very interesting.
sentences.zh: 是的，在这里找妻子非常有意思。

sentences.en: Tell us more.
sentences.zh: 再给我们讲讲。

sentences.en: Yes, let’s say a young man wants to marry a girl.
sentences.zh: 好吧，假设一个年轻人想娶一个女孩。

sentences.en: So he has to ask her father and he says before you can marry my daughter, you have to do a task.
sentences.zh: 他得去问女孩的父亲，父亲会说，在娶我女儿之前，你必须完成一项任务。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: So what type of task does the young man have to do, PK?
sentences.zh: 那么年轻人要做哪种任务呢，PK？

sentences.en: Well, for example, he has to show that he can take a kill away from a lion.
sentences.zh: 嗯，比如，他得证明自己能从狮子嘴边夺走猎物。

sentences.en: What do you mean ‘take a kill away from a lion’?
sentences.zh: 你说‘从狮子嘴边夺走猎物’是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, imagine a lion kills an antelope or another large animal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，想象一下，狮子杀死了一只羚羊或另一只大型动物。

sentences.en: The young man has to find that lion and get the meat, so he can show that he has courage.
sentences.zh: 年轻人必须找到那头狮子，把肉拿走，这样才能证明自己有勇气。

sentences.en: That’s important for his future family.
sentences.zh: 这对他的未来家庭很重要。

sentences.en: Wow, but how can you do that?
sentences.zh: 哇，可你怎么做得到呢？

sentences.en: How can you find a lion and its kill?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能找到狮子和它捕获的猎物？

sentences.en: You have to look.
sentences.zh: 你得观察。

sentences.en: You have to look for the big birds, the vultures.
sentences.zh: 你得寻找那些大鸟，也就是秃鹫。

sentences.en: They are watching the lion because they want some of the meat.
sentences.zh: 它们盯着狮子，因为它们也想分一点肉。

sentences.en: OK, so let’s say you find the lion and its kill.
sentences.zh: 好，假设你找到了狮子和它的猎物。

sentences.en: How can you then get the meat?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么把肉拿走？

sentences.en: Isn’t that dangerous?
sentences.zh: 那不是很危险吗？

sentences.en: Yes, of course the lion is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 是的，狮子当然很危险。

sentences.en: You mustn’t take the meat away from the lion at night.
sentences.zh: 你不能在晚上把肉从狮子那里拿走。

sentences.en: You have to do that during the day.
sentences.zh: 你必须在白天做这件事。

sentences.en: Why’s that?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: During the day it’s very hot.
sentences.zh: 白天天气很热。

sentences.en: And the big cats can’t run fast when it’s hot.
sentences.zh: 而大型猫科动物天热时跑不快。

sentences.en: A man can run even when it’s very hot, but lions can’t.
sentences.zh: 人在很热的时候还能跑，但狮子不行。

sentences.en: No?
sentences.zh: 不行吗？

sentences.en: No, they can’t.
sentences.zh: 不行，它们跑不动。

sentences.en: When they eat some meat, they feel very, very hot and get very tired.
sentences.zh: 它们吃了肉以后，会非常非常热，也非常累。

sentences.en: So they often just lie around and they sleep all the time during the day.
sentences.zh: 所以它们常常只是躺着，白天大部分时间都在睡觉。

sentences.en: At night they are more dangerous because they don’t sleep.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，它们更危险，因为它们不睡觉。

sentences.en: And at night their eyes are better than your eyes.
sentences.zh: 而且晚上它们的眼睛比你的眼睛更好用。

sentences.en: So you can’t get the kill from the lion at night.
sentences.zh: 所以你不能在晚上从狮子那里夺走猎物。

sentences.en: OK, so you have to do that during the day.
sentences.zh: 好，所以你必须在白天做这件事。

sentences.en: But what do you do to get the kill from the lion?
sentences.zh: 可是你要怎么做才能从狮子那里拿到猎物呢？

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: So let’s say the lion is sleeping.
sentences.zh: 假设狮子正在睡觉。

sentences.en: You hold your spear in your hand.
sentences.zh: 你手里握着长矛。

sentences.en: You have to be very quiet.
sentences.zh: 你必须非常安静。

sentences.en: And you go up to that lion.
sentences.zh: 然后你走到那头狮子跟前。

sentences.en: Do you attack him with your spear?
sentences.zh: 你要用长矛攻击它吗？

sentences.en: Kill him?
sentences.zh: 把它杀死？

sentences.en: No, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: You just go up to him and shout, ‘Arrrrggggghhhhh!’
sentences.zh: 你只要走到它跟前，大喊一声‘啊啊啊啊！’

sentences.en: You mustn’t hurt him or kill him, just surprise him, shock him, so he runs away.
sentences.zh: 你不能伤害它，也不能杀死它，只要吓它一跳、让它震惊，它就跑掉了。

sentences.en: Wow!
sentences.zh: 哇！
